email_subject: Urgent: Duplicate charge of $4,850 on our corporate invoice
email_body:
Hello Billing Support,

Our finance department discovered that invoice INV-2026-8819 for $4,850.00 was charged twice to our corporate account on October 28th.
Our account shows two identical pending transactions within 4 minutes of each other.
Please reverse the duplicate transaction immediately and issue an updated billing receipt.

Sincerely,
David Miller
Finance Director, Nexus Logistics
Contact: +1 312-555-9012
